GlobalPolicy.module-level-focus: Fast deterministic unit and widget checks close to the module.
GlobalPolicy.wave-level-focus: Checks only merged surfaces touched by the current wave.
GlobalPolicy.autonomy-gate: Each shared module needs commands, scenarios, observable evidence, and wave/phase follow-up before long autonomous execution.
GlobalPolicy.redaction: No secrets or network credentials in logs.

VF-001.NAME: TelemetryDecryption
VF-001.scenario: GT7 UDP packet is received, decrypted with Salsa20, and mapped to TelemetryData.
VF-001.expected-outcome: TelemetryData contains correct speed, RPM, tire, fuel, and gear values matching the game state.

VF-002.NAME: RealTimeUIUpdate
VF-002.scenario: TelemetryData stream triggers gauge and graph widget rebuilds.
VF-002.expected-outcome: Gauges animate smoothly at 60fps; color transitions reflect RPM range; throttle/brake graph updates in real-time.

VF-003.NAME: SportDailyRaces
VF-003.scenario: Daily race data is fetched from API and displayed.
VF-003.expected-outcome: Race schedule, track, car class, and timing data render correctly.
